notes.title: Marron's Day out now!
notes.notes:
Hi! I just released another game called Marron's Day, which is a silly pocket-sized adventure where you play as a bunny trying to save the town festival! 🐰

It's very cute so if you like this game I think you should check it out ✨️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620590/Marrons_Day/

Right now there's a launch sale!

notes.title: Silly adventure game Marron's Day coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello! I just launched the Steam page for my new game, Marron's Day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/1f85862df610561c7cf21479e11566b460dcaadd.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/60a209afb154364d2b00a8dfef1588cf64319573.gif[/img] 

Marron's Day is a silly adventure game where you're a bunny! You love your friends but love carrots even more. Explore the town, run errands for your animal friends, and don't let anyone catch you swiping the carrots from the garden (again)! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620590/Marrons_Day/

Explore town, help your friends... and steal carrots?

Wishlist this retro bunny adventure now! If you liked this game by me, I think you might like Marron's Day too 🐰 It has a cast of fun and cute characters with relaxing gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/fb6a0d6ea91018206602d5dde9c1728bf211640e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival Soundtrack Stream & New Game Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/3c64d566b2ee095427c0a6e2707d29ce9125f090.png[/img]

For the Storyteller's Festival, there'll be a soundtrack stream for A HERO AND A GARDEN starting 8:00 PM PDT on March 25th! Tune in and enjoy some relaxing fantasy BGM.

The game is also on sale for the whole duration of the festival! 🍒

Also, my new game A TAVERN FOR TEA just released today! If you like A HERO AND A GARDEN, you should check it out - it's a fantasy tea-brewing adventure set in the same universe as A HERO AND A GARDEN.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319470/A_TAVERN_FOR_TEA/

notes.title: A HERO AND A GARDEN will be in the Storyteller's Festival!
notes.notes:
A HERO AND A GARDEN will be participating in the Storyteller's Festival, a celebration of narrative games!

As well, my upcoming game A TAVERN FOR TEA will also be participating.

The event starts March 25 (PST) and goes through to April 1.

notes.title: A TAVERN FOR TEA is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
My new game [b]A TAVERN FOR TEA[/b] is coming to Steam on March 24th! Listen to your customers' worries and brew them the tea that they didn't know they needed. 

The game was originally made for a game jam in 2019 and this Steam version is an expanded version of that with updated 1080p graphics, a new in-game gallery, an extra after-hours teatime mode, and more translations!

Brew tea, chat with customers, and make connections.

Wishlist the game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319470/A_TAVERN_FOR_TEA/

notes.title: a pet shop after dark is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412579/6fd3264c661ca54c023037ae42bf13eee042b8a7.gif[/img]

My new game [b]a pet shop after dark[/b] is out now. It's a horror point-and-click adventure! There's a 10% launch sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934800/a_pet_shop_after_dark/

Come work for a strange pet shop and be remunerated very handsomely so long as you don't stick your nose too far into places where it doesn't belong...

Awaiting you at the pet shop are...
[list]
[*] Little plants thirsty for water
[*] Hungry pets you cannot see
[*] Puzzles to enjoy in a safe working environment
[/list]We can't wait for you to join us... 🔍

notes.title: a pet shop after dark coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[b]a pet shop after dark[/b], my new horror point-and-click adventure game, is coming to Steam! Water the plants, feed the pets, and DON'T turn off the lights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/25613be335b6de1659b2ad55a99f29f777f0507d.gif[/img]

While it's different in genre, if you like the storytelling in this game, I think you'll like [b]a pet shop after dark[/b] too.

There's a demo available now (with a demo-exclusive story), so you can see for yourself! Check out the page and wishlist the game now 🔍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934800/a_pet_shop_after_dark/

notes.title: A HERO AND A GARDEN is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello! The fantasy gardening visual novel and clicker game A HERO AND A GARDEN is out now!

[previewyoutube=H-kzSejGiQI;full][/previewyoutube]
In A HERO AND A GARDEN, play as a fairytale hero and help him garden, since saving the princess didn't go that well. Harvest berries, complete requests, and repair the town (that you destroyed)!

There's a launch discount of 10% for both the game and the soundtrack, and you can buy them together in a bundle to save more!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25513/A_HERO_AND_A_GARDEN__Game__Soundtrack/

I hope you'll enjoy the game!
